title: A marketing professor puts the book in front of his students — 'a MUST READ for all business students'
summary: Elmer teaches marketing and spent his earlier career as an automotive parts sales and marketing executive. He posted chart photos from the book, set shareholder primacy alongside Cory Doctorow's enshittification, and argued that a mission statement written on top of such a charter tells customers and employees something untrue.
blockquote: If a company’s legal purpose is to maximize shareholder value, every tool it uses, including strategy, its business model and experiments, has already been corrupted.
attribution_title: Professor · former automotive parts sales and marketing executive
